result:
The problem asks for the exponent $c$ in the quantitative Beurling–Helson theorem. The proposed answer $c=\tfrac{1}{22}$ matches my recollection of the Konyagin–Shkredov result, which gives affinity under $O(\log^{1/22-\varepsilon}|z|)$ growth. The background claims (Kahane's conjecture with the $\log|n|$ threshold and his $\sqrt{\log\log}$-type result) also agree with my recollection. I could not verify the citation details or rule out a later improvement from memory, so my confidence is moderate.

VERDICT: ACCEPT
CONFIDENCE: 3
